passage.text: Hi, Nam! I'm in Lumpini Park now.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! aɪm ɪn lʊmˈpiːni ˈpɑːrk ˈnaʊ.

passage.text: A man is running, and two girls are sitting on a bench.
passage.reading: ə ˈmæn ɪz ˈrʌnɪŋ, ənd ˈtuː ˈɡɜːrlz ər ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑːn ə ˈbɛntʃ.

passage.text: Three kids are looking at a big lizard near the pond.
passage.reading: ˈθriː ˈkɪdz ər ˈlʊkɪŋ ət ə ˈbɪɡ ˈlɪzərd ˈnɪr ðə ˈpɑːnd.

passage.text: And me? I'm eating ice cream!
passage.reading: ənd ˈmiː? aɪm ˈiːtɪŋ ˈaɪs ˌkriːm!
